notes.title: 15-Year Anniversary Launch Party
notes.content:
[h1]We’re excited to announce that the 15-Year Anniversary Patch launches today![/h1]

This post will prepare you for what is in store as part of the patch as well as what you should expect going into it.

[h2]15-Year Anniversary Event[/h2]

Better late than never! To celebrate 15-Years of APB: Reloaded we’re introducing the 15-Year Anniversary event role, packed to the brim with Joker Tickets and exclusive Titles.

Additionally log in between now and the 13th of August to earn the "Ladder Climber" Title as a login reward! 

[h2]Gamersfirst Anti-Cheat (GFAC)[/h2]

This patch also introduces our in-house Anti-Cheat GFAC - This project has been months in the making and we’re extremely happy to finally get it out the door so we can start tackling the cheating problem head on.

GFAC is made entirely in-house and it has been a significant project. We are dedicated to improving it until we’re satisfied with the results - However, this is entirely new tech and after weeks of testing we are at the stage where we can only move forward by releasing the Anti-Cheat and tackling issues as they occur which could mean that things may be bumpy for the first week or two as we weed through any issues that get reported.

We wouldn’t have been able to get this fair without the help of some very dedicated community members, and now its up to you to jump in and help us push it forward. While we’re going to be watching GFAC closely we would also like to urge all of you to let us know about any issues related to GFAC that you encounter so we can fix said issues them as soon as possible in the dedicated “GFAC Known Issues” thread on both Discord and the Forums!

[h2]Leaderboards (Beta)[/h2]

Todays patch also adds our new Leaderboard System with its first season official starting on the 1st of August! 

This is another entirely new system for APB. With that in mind, August is our Leaderboards Beta phase. While we feel we have built something extremely versatile, we need to experiment with what works and what doesn’t over the next few months. We plan to move out of the Leaderboards Beta phase in early 2026 so that we can expand on the system with the things we learned. 

Again, this is where you can help us! Feedback will shape this system into being the best it can possibly be so you have any please make sure to submit it in the official Leaderboards feedback threads on both the Forum and Discord!

[b]IMPORTANT PSA:[/b] If you are using a config that uses an edited “DefaultEngine.ini” file you will need to either repair your game and redo your DefaultEngine.ini changes in the new file provided or manually edit your existing file and add the following in your [Engine.DataStoreClient] array: 
+GlobalDataStoreClasses="APBUserInterface.cUIDataStore_Leaderboard”

[b]Not doing so will result in a game crash when opening the Leaderboards UI![/b]

[h2]Premium[/h2]

Todays release also marks the release of our revamped Premium service offering new rewards. You can read all about it in our dedicated blog post from a few weeks ago [url=https://www.gamersfirst.com/apb/news/2025/6/28/premium-2025]here[/url] but here is a short summary:

The new Premium subscription will cost $4.99 / 500 G1C, and here are the new benefits:

[list]
[*] Receive 1500 Joker Tickets each month ($3 in value)
[*] Up to a 30 percent bonus to all Contact Standing (XP) gains
[*] 125 percent bonus to all APB$ (in-game currency) gains
[*] 20 Percent discount on most items in the ARMAS Marketplace
[*] Access to the Premium ARMAS Vault containing three items rotating Bi-Weekly such as Items usually only found during sales or items with an increased Premium discount
[*] Use your Clan name as your character Title
[*] And more perks coming in the future like Premium Leaderboards with special rewards
[/list]

Additionally Players that had premium prior to Premium becoming free will have that premium amount reinstated - If you did not have your Premium days reinstated please contact Customer Support by Emailing “support@littleorbit.com”!

[h2]15-Year Anniversary ARMAS Sale![/h2]

As part of our Event we will also be hosting an ARMAS sale, offering an additional 20% off for the following items:

[list]
[*] 25000 Joker Tickets

[h2]What’s to come[/h2]

In weeks following the Anniversary patch we’re going to spend some time making Quality of Life fixes and some improvements to any issues found.

Then we will be working on the finishing touches to the next update titled “Legends” - We understand that our initial target of launching Legends two weeks after the Anniversary was a bit too ambitious so we’re going to monitor how the new features introduced in the Anniversary patch are doing before setting our sights on a potential release date for the Legends patch. 

Thank you for being a part of APB: Reloaded and helping shape its legacy over the past 15 years. Log in, check out the event, and don’t miss your chance for exclusive rewards!

notes.title: EU Outage
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,
[/p][p]Yesterday, we took the game down for standard maintenance and to switch Anti DDoS providers.[/p][p]This was supposed to be a pretty simple procedure... but like all things APB, it quickly unraveled and turned into a cluster.

Our fiber connection in Amsterdam has had some issues, and it went out midstream.[/p][p]They got in back online, but an issue with other hardware prevented the EU World from fully functioning.[/p][p]We sorted out those issues, only to have the optic fiber connection go bad again.[/p][p][/p][p]At this point, we have worked with our Amsterdam host to replace all the hardware giving us issues. The goal is get EU back online as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]To be clear, no player data was lost. The outage has been a cascade of fixing underlying network issues that were missed when we put Amsterdam online, or came up during our Anti DDoS cutover. I'll give updates here until that happens.[/p][p] [/p][p]Then over the next week, we will replace all of the other hardware that has been not been 100%.[/p][p] [/p][p]To be continued..[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]Matt[/p]

notes.title: Easter 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Get Ready - The Egg Hunt Returns![/h1]

Starting April 16th, dive into our wild Easter-themed chaos in special versions of Financial and Waterfront. Your mission? Gather as many eggs as possible before time runs out by targeting bunnies, chickens, and other players! Complete challenges to earn new titles and valuable Joker Tickets.

Watch for animals roaming the streets - mug bunnies for one egg, or chickens for up to five. The real excitement comes from player encounters: perform a full mugging to steal all their eggs, or take them down for half their stash (rounded up).

To protect your precious eggs, deliver them to contacts throughout the district. Here's everything else you need to know:

[list]
[*]It's a full-on free-for-all - no teams, no alliances.
[*]Each match runs for 20 minutes.
[*]Mugging any target - chicken, bunny, or player - gives you a temporary speed boost and brief invulnerability. You'll see eggs floating around your character when this shield is active.
[*]While shielded, you can't use weapons, and the protection disappears if you enter a vehicle or use certain mods.
[*]Players can't interrupt your mugging, so snatch those eggs in peace.
[*]If you're in the top 20% of egg carriers in the district, you must deposit your haul before returning to the lobby.
[*]Collect the most eggs to become the Egg Lord - but watch out! Everyone will see your location on the map, making you the prime target.
[/list]

Additionally, running from the 16th of April until the 30th April is a login reward campaign awarding every character that logs in during that period with the “[i]A New Me[/i]” player title.

[b]Happy hunting, and may the most egg-crazed player win![/b]

notes.title: Unexpected Downtime and Recovery Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For players who may have missed our updates on social media and updates on our Steam Forums, we want to provide a full recap of what has been happening behind the scenes over the past few weeks and share the latest progress on restoring our servers.

On February 2nd, all three of our world wide data centers went dark and all our servers went offline without notice. We were informed by our primary network hosting provider they had encountered a serious issue requiring an unspecified amount of days to fix. This forced APB:Reloaded and GamersFirst offline. Unfortunately, we were not provided with an ETA at the time, but we immediately began working with our provider to resolve the issue.

After ongoing discussions, we were initially told services would be restored by Friday, February 7th. However, as delays continued, and deadlines were missed, we made the very difficult decision to terminate all services and implement an entirely new hosting solution to regain control over our infrastructure and ensure long-term stability.

This process has involved quickly securing all of our existing servers, acquiring new servers to meet player demand, and kicking off multiple network colocation and transit contracts around the world. Once we secured new servers, our team began working on restoring services. At the same time, we finalized development for what would have been our Valentine's Day event. As promised, this event will be launched for APB Reloaded once the game is back online.

As of right now, here is what we have accomplished for APB Reloaded, Fallen Earth, and GamersFirst:
[list]
[*] 2/21 (Friday): Network circuits were scheduled for provisioning and activation.
[*] 2/24 (Monday): Hosting cabinets were finalized and handed over for setup.
[*] Server Racking Begins: We moved and racked all the necessary hardware for both NA and EU data centers.[/list]
All servers in North America have been set up, and we are currently waiting for one final part before going live.

In Europe, hardware has been moved to Amsterdam, racked, and plugged in. We are now waiting on circuit activation. Our CEO is currently in Amsterdam, tirelessly overseeing everything to ensure a smooth transition. Our team is actively working on-site in both locations to complete the setup as quickly as possible.

We truly appreciate the patience and support from our dedicated players. This transition has been a massive undertaking, and we are doing everything possible to ensure that APB Reloaded and Fallen Earth return stronger than before.

We are posting regular updates on our Discord, and we welcome everyone to join us there for the latest news and discussions: discord.gg/littleorbit


We will continue providing updates via Steam, Discord, and social media as we approach the final stages of this process.

Thank you for being patient with us and we'll see you back in-game soon!

notes.title: APB Reloaded v1.32 'Mobilize' goes live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/24f24383514a8741174182b1743a54be47d9cc50.png[/img]
As the year draws to a close, APB Reloaded v1.32 "Mobilize" delivers a wide range of improvements, new features, and seasonal content. After the significant New Horizon update in August and a return of the 2018 Halloween festivities in October, the focus now turns to refining matchmaking, strengthening anti-cheat measures, and celebrating the holidays in style.

Below are the key highlights and additions included with the "Mobilize" update and the upcoming Holiday 2024 event starting December 18th.

[h2]Cross-District Matchmaking[/h2]
What’s New:
[list]
[*] Removal of Threat Districts: Traditional threat-based district segregation has been eliminated. Players can now be matched with others across all instances of a specific district type.
[*] Easier Access to Matches: Instead of waiting for a full district, players can relax, explore, socialize, or engage in faction-based gameplay. Once a suitable match is found, participants will be seamlessly moved to a new server.
[*] Expanding the Player Pool: Previous district caps limited opponents to a small pool. With cross-district matchmaking, the entire player population in the same type of district is now available for match creation, greatly increasing the chances of balanced matches.
[/list]
Future Plans:
The development team intends to enable cross-type district and even cross-world matchmaking, further broadening the player pool and enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

[h2]SARD Anti-Cheat Enhancements[/h2]
Multi-Layered Protection:
[list]
[*] Real-Time and Daily Detections: All three modes of the new SARD anti-cheat system are now fully online. Some methods provide immediate detections, while others run daily analyses to catch less obvious issues.
[*] Refined Ban Policy: Players identified with 100% cheating confidence are subject to discretionary bans. Those with lower-confidence detections accrue “Cheat Points.” These points may lead to restricted matchmaking or limited features until they expire, reducing exposure to suspected cheaters while minimizing false-positive impacts on regular players.
[/list]
Monitoring and Adjustments:
The system will be closely observed, with prompt adjustments made as needed. The goal is to maintain a fair, enjoyable environment for all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/cd36cb473a9875787dfc7b4a14bc6ec306dc8000.png[/img]
[h2]Holiday 2024 Event: Starting December 18th[/h2]
This year’s holiday festivities return to the classic spirit of APB: Reloaded’s Christmas events. Progression roles have been tweaked so players can grind at their own pace. New titles, Joker Tickets, and unique weapon unlocks await participants who engage with the various activities and challenges.

[h3]The Beacon Festivities:[/h3]

Five Rotating Minigames: Two new gun games join the rotation
[list]
[*] “Blast from the Past” Gun Game: Experience legacy weapons with original stats, including minimal sprint delays for high-speed combat.
[*] “Redhill Experiments…?” Gun Game: Experiment with absurd weaponry, from the PMG-SD ‘Staple Gun’ to the N-SPiN 3310, and even a Redhill attempt at “Snowparo.”
[/list]
Returning favorites include:
[list]
[*] Prototype Testing Grounds – A fan-favorite pushing the limits of regular APB weapon rules.
[*] 12 Deaths of Christmas – Classic Gun Game with adjusted mods for smoother play.
[*] Snowball Fight! – Faction-based snowball skirmishes using a buffed HohohoPGL.
[/list]
[h3]Elfin’ Around Role:[/h3]
Participating in Beacon minigames levels the new “Elfin’ Around” role. Progression grants six new titles, 2400 Joker Tickets, and permanent access to lease the DOW Stock NFCP 2 shotgun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/c7cab0b5d2a338cbdbe7af9225fe9f0ff4a20004.png[/img]

[h3]Mission District Mayhem:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Seasonal weapons (HohohoPGL and Snowball grenades) will be sent via in-game mail. Use them to progress the returning “Snowball Fight!” Weapon Role in Mission Districts and earn Joker Tickets, new titles, and the Candy Cane weapon skin.
[*] Look out for special community-wide Snowball Fights and Gun Games organized by Staff and GMs throughout the holiday season, offering additional Joker Ticket rewards.
[/list]
[h3]Seasonal Vendors:[/h3]
The Elves have refreshed their stock, allowing players to earn five titles from previous Christmas events and purchase all six Christmas-themed weapon skins for Joker Tickets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/7d34707a848b0dfa952680282c19c703607bd467.png[/img]
[h2]Joker Ticket Store Additions[/h2]
Wilde at the Joker Distribution Store is expanding the lineup with permanent weapon additions, including:

[list]
[*] CBMP-45 ‘Arrow’
[*] Norseman ‘Hel’
[*] Norseman ‘Tyr’
[*] Norseman ‘Hoenir’
[*] Joker RFP-9-SD “Talon”
[*] S-AS PDW “Hotfoot”
[/list]
These additions are timed perfectly with the surge in Joker Ticket rewards from holiday activities, giving players more options to spend their earnings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/b32711b1b47d5acfa02a55890c045d400ef54765.png[/img]
[h2]New Legendary Weapon: VBR ‘Enchantress’[/h2]
The VBR ‘Enchantress’ is a high-mobility, fast-firing, two-shot-to-kill sniper rifle with limited range but superior accuracy on the move. Inspired by the original N-HVR 243 ‘Scout,’ it enhances the jump-shooting dynamic without recreating past balance issues. To fully leverage its mobile accuracy, Hunting Sight 3 is required, ensuring that this Legendary remains balanced and skill-oriented.

[h2]Holiday 2024 ARMAS Sale & New Items[/h2]
From December 18th, all ARMAS items will be discounted by 15%. Additionally, a variety of permanent and limited-time seasonal items will be available, including:

New Permanent Additions:
[list]
[*] Future Tech Weapon Skin
[*] CBMP-45 ‘Arrow’
[/list]
Limited-Time Christmas 2024 Items:
[list]
[*] Stocks out Bundle (N-TEC 5 Dvah Stock, OCA-EW 626 NFCP 3 Stock, JG-1140 Tactical)
[*] Christmas Classics Bundle (Six Christmas-themed weapon skins: Candy Cane, Christmas Holly, Snowflake, Santa Sleigh, Sugar Plum Fairy, Nutcracker)
[/list]
Returning Limited-Time Christmas Items:
[list]
[*] Christmas Symbol Bundle
[*] Holiday 2019 All Items
[*] Holiday Symbol Bundle
[*] Slay Bells Decal Sheet
[*] Ugly Holiday Sweater Bundle
[/list]
[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
The APB Reloaded team appreciates the community’s dedication and support throughout 2024.

The changes and additions introduced this year are intended to set a strong foundation for 2025, aiming for improved fairness, more frequent matches, and fresh content that caters to a wide range of playstyles. Whether participating in epic firefights, enjoying minigames in The Beacon, or spending time in the Social Districts designing new outfits, there’s something for everyone.

Enjoy the holidays, the new matchmaking system, the anti-cheat enhancements, the Legendary VBR ‘Enchantress,’ and the wide array of new Joker Store items that players can earn for free.

Here’s to making the remainder of 2024 enjoyable and setting the stage for a fantastic 2025.

notes.title: Epidemic Returns: Halloween 2024
notes.content:
[b]The Epidemic Returns: Can You Survive San Paro’s Deadliest Infection?[/b]

Hey everyone! After a long break, Epidemic has returned, bringing chaos back to San Paro! Though it hasn’t been seen since 2018, the dangerous objective remains unchanged: three rival corporations are competing to unleash their deadly pathogens and infect the city’s population, turning citizens into mindless zombies. It’s a fight for domination, but only one virus will prevail. The question is: which corporation will reign supreme?

[b]Meet the Epidemic Teams:[/b] The battle lines are drawn, and three corporations are trying to unleash their deadly toxins across San Paro:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/7d39caf0724039fac3f6ce1e70a285a151f1ce9d.png[/img]

Epidemic Teams
Who do you think will come out on top?

How Epidemic Works:

Epidemic Daily Activities: Daily side tasks and rewards will be randomly assigned when you enter the event. Completing these challenges will help you level your Epidemic 2024 role as well as awarding some extra Joker Tickets for your efforts and spicy new Titles!

Additionally, you may sometimes encounter rare daily activities which are a little harder to complete but award you with the Blue Glow in the Dark Weapon skin or coveted Witches Hat!

[b]Game Goals:[/b]
1 Transportation of Toxin Barrels: In the Epidemic District, your team starts in one of three territories—top, bottom left, or bottom right. Your job is to collect toxin barrels from your starting zone and carry them to neutral territories to spread your infection. But beware—these barrels degrade over time and will eventually explode if you don’t act quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/f1631e7377d7dce8d69d40e17dcd2faaf0236d13.png[/img]

Barrels are also vulnerable to enemy attacks, so you’ll need to protect them while transporting. Once you capture a territory, new barrels will spawn there, allowing you to infect even more areas and strengthen your control.

[b]2 Conquer Neutral Territories:
[/b]
At the beginning of the match, six neutral territories will appear on your map, marked as task checkpoints. Your goal is to capture these zones by placing your team’s toxin barrel within the boundaries. The more areas your team captures, the faster your infection spreads. Reach 100% infection to trigger the final showdown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/141410fd97288092a2a125f16c1fc99b02fad804.png[/img]

[b]3 Protect or Destroy Captured Territories:[/b]

Once a toxin barrel is placed in a territory, the borders turn your team’s color, and a large barrel bundle spawns to maintain control of the area. Defend it well, because enemy teams can destroy the bundle to neutralize the territory. The barrels are tough but not invulnerable, and they’re surrounded by toxic gas that harms enemy players, making them tricky to destroy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/5328eadbead3f45ceeb0f57a6f78b12ad019c1a6.png[/img]

[b]End Game: The Battle for Havalynd Central Memorial Park[/b]

1 The fight to control Havalynd Central Memorial Park:

The first team to hit 100% infection triggers the final phase of the game—the battle for Havalynd Central Memorial Park. To win, your team must capture and hold this territory.

If the park is neutral, all you need to do is place a small toxin barrel and let the infection take hold. But if an enemy team has already claimed it, you’ll need to neutralize their hold before placing your own barrel. Even if your team hasn’t hit 100% infection yet, you can still try to take control of the park, forcing your rivals to recapture it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/bcaa4f0e0e2619a0a3203ca09598e05d2945f5bd.png[/img]

Defend your barrel within the Park’s boundaries from enemy attacks for 90 seconds and secure your team's victory.

[b]Epidemic 2024 Rewards:[/b]
With this years run of Epidemic players can earn a bunch of new Titles as well as some of Epidemics old rewards such as two out of the three weapon skins as well as the Epidemic symbols! Additionally, every level of the Epidemic role award you with 150 Joker Tickets!

[list]
[*] Rank 1: Bullet Boo Title
[*] Rank 2: Spooktacular Title
[*] Rank 3: Dead Aim Title
[*] Rank 4: Haunted Title, Epidemic Skin Selector
[*] Rank 5: Epidemic Symbol Pack
[*] Rank 6: Mummy Issues Title, Halloween Backpack Selector
[*] Rank 7: Zombicine, Necrocite, and Undedox Symbols
[*] Rank 8: Silent Killer Title, Epidemic Skin Selector
[/list]

[b]Halloween 2024 Sale: Spooky Deals Await![/b]
To celebrate the return of Epidemic, we're launching the Halloween 2024 Sale with an array of killer deals. Stock up on Joker Tickets, character slots, and some of your favorite weapons like the OCA Nano ‘Butcher,’ Colby .45 AP, and the VAS C2 ‘Troublemaker.’ All SWARM, ISSR-A, FR0G, and ATAC 424 variants are also discounted, along with exclusive kits and vehicles like the Criminal and Enforcer Firehawk sets and the Han Coywolf Bundle.

This Halloween brings a set of Biohazard-themed weapon skins for Undedox, Zombicine, and Necrocite, alongside classic spooky skins like Halloween Ghost and Glow in the Dark Blue. Returning favorites include the Halloween Classics and 2018 bundles, as well as costume and animal symbol sheets to let your creativity shine.

Don't miss out on these hauntingly good deals while dominating San Paro!

notes.title: APB Reloaded v1.31: New Horizon: Meet Lucas and Lynette
notes.content:
Meet Lucas and Lynette

Introducing Lucas Van Rooyen and Lynette Casey, two fearsome higher-ups in their factions that are looking for new recruits to do their bidding in return for rewards that will help you stay on top of the ever-changing street wars of San Paro.

[h2][b]Unlocking Lucas and Lynette[/b][/h2]
Unlike previous contacts, Lucas and Lynette are not of the specialist tier, instead, these contacts are positioned a little more in APB Reloaded’s mid-game progression and have 15 levels each which means that these contacts can be unlocked as early as Rank 88 if you focus your efforts on maxing just Blood Rose or Prentiss Tiger contacts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/57f254d9a2a589bc5afa0737b0dad6baadffef0f.png[/img]

Unlocking Lucas Van Rooyen requires you to reach level 10 with the following Blood Rose contacts:
[list]
[*] Tyron Sennet
[*] Jeung Bloodrose
[/list]
Unlocking Lynette Casey requires you to reach level 10 with the following Prentiss Tigers contacts:
[list]
[*] Chiza
[*] Byeong Lee
[/list]
If you have already maxed out the contacts named above you will be referred to Lucas or Lynette when logging in with your character on Version 1.31 “New Horizon”.

When reaching the maximum level with Lucas Van Rooyen, he will refer you to Michael Simeone. Similarly, reaching the maximum level with Lynette Casey will result in her referring you to Orlenz' Moretti.

[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
New contacts bring new rewards, so here’s a quick overview of what Lucas and Lynette have in store for you!

[h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3]
The following weapons are available as part of the standard contact progression with Lucas and Lynette:
[list]
[*] Showstopper Pistol
[*] OCA ‘Nano’ Pistol
[*] Obeya CAP40-C NFCP 2
[*] N-SSW 74 Adeen
[*] VBR ‘Temptress’
[*] VAS C2 NFCP 1
[*] N-TEC 7 Adeen
[*] N-HVR 243 ‘Scout’ Nol
[/list]

If you have maxed out Lucas or Lynette you may also be eligible for a rare daily activity awarding you with the following weapon:
[list]
[*] N-ISSR-B ‘Recon’
[/list]
Additionally the following Weapon skins are awarded for reaching the maximum level of Lucas or Lynette:
[list]
[*] Short Circuit - Blue
[*] Short Circuit - Red
[*] Short Circuit - Green
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications[/b][/h3]
New contacts are a perfect opportunity to add new modifications and spice up the gameplay, here are three new modifications as well as one returning modification available in v1.31 New Horizon:
[list]
[*] Display Banner
[/list]
Orange character mod allows you to place down a large Display Banner with your personal symbol on it! This feature was originally a refer-a-friend reward, and we are bringing it back for those who missed the chance to unlock it previously.
[list]
[*] Long-Range Rifling
[/list]
The red weapon modification increases your weapon's effective range by 25% at the cost of reducing the weapon's rate of fire by 10%. Additionally, burst weapons suffer a 20% burst rate penalty for using this mod.

[previewyoutube=oGmTk54Ong4;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Muzzle Brake (Vertical)
[/list]
Muzzle Brake (Vertical) is a red weapon modification that will reduce the vertical recoil of your weapon by 30% at a minor drawback of increasing horizontal recoil by 7%.

[previewyoutube=_Eb-u8e9vVU;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Suspension Tuning
[/list]
Lastly Suspension Tuning, our very first “Tuning” vehicle modification uses a red vehicle modification slot. This modification will decrease the Suspension Stiffness and Damping of your vehicle by 50% with no additional downside. We’re excited to see which cars can use this modification to greatly empower their maneuverability.

These modifications are going to be available for purchase after unlocking them and players will not receive a free version as part of unlocking them as we felt like this behavior should be kept exclusively for Specialist contacts.

[b]Vehicles[/b]
The following vehicles are unlocked as part of leveling Lucas and Lynette:

[*] Growl S3
[*] Sungnyemun Mirage S-22
[/list]

[h3][b]Clothing[/b][/h3]
Maxing our Lucas or Lynette will award you with their respective outfit as well as Blood Rose/Prentiss Tiger inspired presets using some of our new clothing items such as the Trench Coat. Here’s a sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/9b00686902ed015488f3038f88a9c7019a3961ad.jpg[/img]

More items require you to have more inventory capacity, fortunately, Lucas and Lynette have you covered! Players will be able to earn the following inventory expansions as part of Lucas and Lynette’s contact progression:

notes.title: Preview from Matt: New Horizon
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

It's been quite a while since we have had a new version of APB this large.

So I thought I would take some time to break everything down that is coming over a series of blog posts. But before I do, I want to acknowledge a couple of things about version 1.31.

First, and most importantly, we focused a lot on new free content. It's something I have wanted to do in the past, but for various reasons we haven't been able to. It's a bit of an experiment, as we're now giving away more free items than ever in the regular progression of the game. We took time to identify and fill in gaps for weapons and vehicles that otherwise weren't available.

Second, this patch brings together content and features that have been in the development for a while. Honestly, it sort of snowballed. As the weeks and months have passed, more and more items have been pushed into this new version. As the name implies, we're hoping New Horizon sets a new bar for APB and offers a "jumping on point" for many players who have felt there was nothing new in the game.

Third, there was a lot of R&D required for this patch. Little Orbit has never added contacts to the game or modified any of the district geometry. In some cases, we had to write entirely new plugins to build compatibility between APB and newer modeling systems. We've also had layoffs, so there was some retraining required to even do some of the things we've already done in the past. Regardless, I feel like our progress will enable updates like to happen a bit more quickly going forward.

Lastly, we are in final testing on many of the components in this patch, but it is our goal to launch Version 1.31 New Horizon in the next couple of weeks.

With that out of the way, let's jump into what is coming.

[b]Major Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] (2) New Contacts - Lucas 'Van' Rooyen and Lynette Casey
[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3952646/896c937a3ca414261750ea901be29c396eab5352.jpg[/img]

These two fearsome higher-ups in their factions are looking for new recruits to do their bidding in return for rewards that will help you stay on top of the ever-changing street wars of San Paro. Both of these characters have been in the APB lore for quite a while, and it was important to me that their rewards and storylines feel on par with other contacts that were already in the game. I will be posting a separate News blog with a full run-down of Lucas and Lynette's rewards soon.

[list]
[*] SARD Anti-Cheat
[/list]
APB has had many different integrations in the past, but I felt it was important to take the proper time to evaluate both old and new solutions. This time around, I had two major criteria: (1) client and server side support and (2) custom integration where Little Orbit collects the penalty information, but we apply our own rules on how to handle cheaters. The team at SARD has been fantastic to work with, and after months of development, we are finally ready to launch.

[list]
[*] Re-distribution of contact rewards and lowered all mod Rank requirements
[/list]
We feel this is a significant quality of life improvement. We decided to lower the Rank requirements for R195l mods to level the playing field between older and newer characters. With that same goal in mind, we also identified gaps in the vehicle progression and redistributed vehicles to unlock more cars sooner. And finally, we added missing weapons like the Showstopper, the NTEC 7c, and the N-HVR '243' 'Scout' to the player progression.

[list]
[*] Changes to the Waterfront
[/list]
We knew we couldn't launch two new Waterfront contacts without addressing some of the player complaints about that district. We've added more cover around common spawn areas and objective locations as well as more access routes to spots that were previously very hard to attack. These edits are still be completed, so I will be posting a separate News blog with the new changes to Waterfront soon.

[list]
[*] The ISSR-C 'Kingdom' Legendary
[/list]
We decided to have a little fun and also add a new legendary. The ISSR-C 'Kingdom' is RedHill Homeland Defense's new cutting-edge, fast, short-ranged burst rifle made up from parts of Nekrova's infamous ISSR weapon series with an integrated RedHill burst module. Its quick four-round bursts make it suitable for close to medium-range fights whilst retaining Nekrova's trademark of deadly accuracy.
[b]
Full Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two new Tier 4 Contacts to the Waterfront district.
[*] Added three new modifications.
[*] Added many new clothing items for both body types.
[*] Added SARD Anti-Cheat.
[*] Reworked many areas of the Waterfront district to improve gameplay.
[*] Added the ISSR-C 'Kingdom' burst rifle as a new Legendary gun available for purchase at Anne inside the Joker Store through Joker Tickets.
[*] Changed the Rank requirement of all mods that previously required a Character Rating of 195 or above. These mods will now have a Rank Requirement of R40, 60, or 80 and cost 20.000, 40.000, and 60.000 APB$ respectively.
[*] Increased the range in which Mobile Spawn Points become invalid from 35m to 55m.
[*] Decreased the Health and Stamina damage to the DMR-AV Sniper Rifle to decrease the range in which it can Kill in two shots from 88-100m to 95-100m. The ability to stun in two shots has been removed entirely. The DMR-SD is unaffected by these changes.
[*] Decreased the range of the OBIR by 5 meters. We are going to revisit this change once we are closer to making larger balance adjustments but we feel like the gun is currently too dominant and would like to address that for the time being.
[*] Added 3-Point Sling 3 to the ARMAS and Joker Store versions of the non-legendary Showstopper Pistol and renamed it to Showstopper 'Quickdraw'.
[*] The following vehicles unlock their 0 to 4-slot versions one entire Contact Tier sooner.
[list][*] Balkan Varzuga
[*] Balkan Ravan
[*] Macchina Calabria
[*] Macchina Cosenza
[*] Packer Ceresco[/list]
[*] Retroactively added the following vehicles to late-game contact progression:
[list]
[*]  Growl S4
[*] [Dolton Fresno D400
[*]  Charge Sentinel CS904
[*]  Dolton Montane D230
[*]  Dolton Montane D430
[*] Balkan Varzuga Rally 353 XS[/list]
[*] The Sungnyemun Mirage now supports primary and secondary police lights.
[*] Fixed various LOD issues of the Sungnyemun Mirage.
[*] Fixed multiple minor issues of the Sungnyemun Mirage.
[*] Added the Mirage 'Sundown' and 'Horizon' presets to the Joker Ticket Store. These were designed by an awesome community member that goes by the name of ElinSylwiaVT.
[/list]
More to come.

Thanks, Matt

notes.title: OTW MATCHMAKING TEST 05/27
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Get ready to join us on OTW this Monday, 05/27/2024, at 6 PM UTC for an hour-long matchmaking test. We need your help to put our new matchmaking code through its paces and iron out any kinks. The more of you who join, the better we can fine-tune our system. Your input is invaluable, so please log in and lend us a hand during this crucial phase.

Remember to create a character on the "NA Test" World of OTW for this test! Your involvement truly counts! Let's work together to make this test a resounding success!

Check out the notes for Matchmaking Improvement below:
[list]
[*] With this build, we have deployed new code based on the existing matchmaking functionality on Live.
[*] Matchmaking has been moved from the World server to operate on its own dedicated Matchmaking server.
[*] Matchmaking will only function in the same district - at least for now.
[*] Backup is once again offered in cases in which the Matchmaker has to create an uneven Match and will add one player to each team trying to increase the overall Match quality to make it more even.
[*] In evenly matched missions both Team Leaders are now offered the option to “Escalate” the mission. If both Team leaders put in a request to escalate players will be added to both teams up to a maximum of 20 players per side. Team leaders will need to agree to Escalate the mission further each time new players are added to the mission.
[*] Fixed an issue related to Backup/Escalation calls that caused the matchmaker to be bottlenecked during the playtest on Sun. May 19.
[*] Fixed the crash issue related to playtest that happened on Thur. May 23.
[/list]
 
If you haven't yet! Make sure to grab the [url=http://apb.patch.ot.gamersfirst.com/APB_OTW_Installer.exe]OTW client[/url] and download it ahead of time so that you can participate.

notes.title: AMA recap
notes.content:
[h2]Where has Matt been?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Matt has been engaged with a special Fallen Earth project funded by a 3rd party investor. Unfortunately, the project was way behind in its deliverables due to technical implementation issues, and has spent the last 4 months course correcting the project.
[*] Soon, Matt aims to lower his development involvement on this project so he can get back to working on other games such as APB and Unsung Story.
[/list]
[h3]Fallen Earth Update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The back-end rewrite is close to being done.
[*] The servers are running on an Operating system that is no longer supported and has problems that make the servers slow down over time.
[*] There is a core issue which is requiring the servers to be manually restarted which needs to be addressed.
[/list]
[h3]Decline in the Gaming Industry:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The gaming industry is experiencing a decline. As such, many companies are being forced to reduce staff and Little Orbit is in the same situation.
[*] Little Orbit has shifted resources to move a previous APB Engineer back on APB. Currently, there are 3 dedicated resources with 3 other support staff.
[/list]
[h3]APB[/h3]

[i]Easy Anti-Cheat:[/i]
[list]
[*] The game has had various Anti-cheats solutions in the past, Epic’s Easy Anti-Cheat has previously worked the best.
[*] LIttleOrbit worked with Epic as a beta partner to help them improve Easy Anti-Cheat which unfortunately led to multiple issues including false-positive bans.
[*] The Easy Anti-Cheat ban-appeal user experience was bad due to the lack of communication between Easy Anti-Cheat and the Players, leading players to think the system was broken.
[*] There will be an unban-wave to address the false-positive bans. (More details on what the unban-wave is going to look like sooner to when it happens)
[*] We’re looking into other solutions to move away from Easy Anti-Cheat but are still investigating our options.
[/list]

[i]Mirage:[/i]
[list]
[*] Matt did a majority of the work on Mirage. He is aware of the issues, which are not difficult to fix, and will return to the project once he is able.
[/list]

[i]Matchmaking:[/i]
[list]
[*] Matt considers Matchmaking as one of the biggest issues APB faces and therefore puts it at the highest possible priority.
[*] Matt is proud of the system when it works but there are issues in its current state. When the system works, the overall match quality is better than the previous system, however, it needs improvements.
[*] Running matches on the World Server rather than on each individual District server was needed for future improvements such as Cross-district matchmaking. However, this has introduced instability to the World server which isn’t ideal.
[*] Since the release of Matchmaking the development efforts were shifted to move the code from running on the World server to its own, exclusive Matchmaking server. This effort is close to being done and the goal is to test it on OTW in the coming weeks.
[*] There are edge cases in the algorithm when players fail to match.
[*] After the initial stability issues of Phase 1 of the new Matchmaking system were worked out, we collected a lot of good feedback regarding backup and we are addressing these issues. We know the Backup UI is confusing and has some bugs.
[*] Matt does not want to get rid of the Faction system for Mission districts, there are better solutions to fixing Matchmaking issues related to lower population.
[*] Matchmaking has always struggled to match high MMR players, especially now that asymmetrical missions are no longer a thing, we are looking into ways of solving this.
[/list]

[i]Server Merge:[/i]
[list]
[*] The merge was tested internally and it had a lot of issues.
[*] There is not going to be a server merge, instead, we pivoted to the Cross-district matchmaking solution which will enable players from different worlds to play in any district regardless of region.
[*] Conflicting names between servers are an issue and we plan on having a Discord-like solution that will let players with duplicate names from different servers be easily identified.
[*] We still plan on releasing inactive names, however, doing so now would cause issues in the future so we are waiting on the right time to release all of the inactive names.
[/list]

[i]Content:[/i]
[list]
[*] The new contacts are still being itemized, Matt was not happy with the previous plans for them.
[*] Some content may be added to previous contacts retroactively.
[*] The Joker Store is an ongoing project and we are committed to adding more things to the Joker Store when we can.
[*] Internally, we’ve had great discussions regarding balance, focusing on buffs to very underutilized weapons that nobody plays.
[*] Players get frustrated when the game is facing issues such as Matchmaking not working and our focus is on Balance passes so we are looking for the right time to do them.
[*] New guns are a cool idea but we would like to make many of the existing guns more compelling first.
[/list]

[i]First-Time User Experience:[/i]
[list]
[*] The tutorial tells you how the basic mechanics work, but does not tell you how APB works which is a massive issue. It is a high priority to look at and fix but not as high on the list as Matchmaking.
[*] Getting PvE into APB is a mess but it would be amazing to have as a way to teach new players.
[*] We are considering a mode for newer players that lets them shoot any weapon in the game in a shooting range while also providing them with more information such as damage numbers while they are within that district.
[/list]

[i]Consoles:[/i]
[list]
[*] Microsoft and Sony do not allow games to be transferred from one publisher to another which has led Little Orbit and Plaion to mutually agree to shut down the console versions.
[*] Once the console versions are fully shut down in September, we have full control over the console versions.
[*] Console ports of the PC versions are likely what is going to be submitted to Microsoft and Sony when we are ready to publish the game on consoles again.
[*] Resubmitting the current console versions is not going to work.
[*] Controller support is being looked at.
[*] Previously Little Orbit had to submit builds to Koch Media which ended up never submitting those builds to Microsoft/Sony due to QA reasons.
[/list]

[i]VOIP:[/i]
[list]
[*] Reloaded had a contract with Vivox that expired some time ago which prompted Vivox to shut down the servers.
[*] VOIP is important for a game like APB and made Console APB special.
[*] We want to bring back VOIP, however, doing so requires a new version of Vivox to be implemented which is time-consuming.
[/list]

[i]APB Priorities: Marketing:[/i]
[list]
[*] Marketing is still on our Radar, however, there are key points that need to be addressed first such as Matchmaking, Anti-Cheat, and new Content such as the new Contacts.
[/list]

[i]Misc:[/i]
[list]
[*] APB can’t be upgraded to Unreal 4/5 though PBR (Physically based rendering) may be possible in the future as well as improvements to APB’s post-processing effects such as some of the original shaders.
[*] Adding more developers to a project doesn’t mean it’ll speed up development, especially when working on complex things such as Matchmaking.
[*] Griefing is still on our list of things to look at and fix.
[*] Translations are heavily outdated - We are considering running our English translations through systems to generate European and Russian translations for players to use - The Russian translation is still supported but outdated.
[*] The Trade-lock system should be better at telling players what they were Trade-locked for.
[*] Most players that are permanently Trade-locked did something and are Trade-locked for a reason such as credit card fraud.
[*] Improvements to the Inventory need to happen.
[*] There’s a lot of documentation on how to make Waterfront a better district.
[*] The Clan system needs an overhaul.
[*] There should be a colorblind mode, however, messing with APB’s colors could introduce new issues.
[*] A way to officially support arranged matches between players is something we would like to support in the future.
[*] The bug that causes characters to slide at high FPS is still on our radar to fix.
[/list]

[h3]Unsung Story[/h3]
[list]
[*] Matt hasn’t given up on the game.
[*] Unsung has a huge upgrade to what is offered internally, about 80% of what was shared publicly is implemented.
[*] Unsung remains a priority on our roadmap.
[/list]

[h3]Customer Support:[/h3]
[list]
[*] LittleOrbit moved away from Zendesk on April 25, 2024 to Zoho which provides more features & flexibility for our current needs.
[*] APB Reloaded customer support has to work with 14-year-old tools which can lead to easier tasks taking more time than usual to resolve.
[*] Recently response times have gone up, we are sorry about this. However, we are committed to solving player issues.
[/list]

notes.title: APB Reloaded Console Sunset
notes.content:
Dear APB Reloaded Console Community,

After careful consideration and evaluation of various factors, Little Orbit and PLAION have decided to sunset APB Reloaded on console platforms. This decision was not made lightly, and we understand that it may come as disappointing news to our dedicated console players who have waited patiently for upgrades and fixes to the game.

The decision to discontinue APB Reloaded on consoles was driven by a combination of technical challenges, resource constraints, and the evolving landscape of gaming. We want to ensure that our players have the best possible gaming experience, and unfortunately, sustaining the game on console platforms has proven increasingly challenging.

[list]
[*] [b]For Xbox players[/b], we previously experienced issues preventing players from making any purchases, but we were able to keep the servers online. Unfortunately, you will have noticed that APB Xbox is currently experiencing technical issues, and the game is currently offline. Unfortunately, we are now unable to bring the game back online.
[*] [b]For PlayStation 4 players[/b], we will begin the sunset phase starting February 1st through August 2nd. As of February 1st, we will be disabling all monetization for these players. This wasn't an easy decision, and we understand the impact it has on our gaming community, but it was unavoidable.
[/list]
As a small consolation, we have created the ability for console players to migrate their characters to PC. APB Reloaded will continue to be available and supported on the PC platform. We encourage console players who wish to continue their APB Reloaded experience to consider joining the PC community.

[list]
[*] [b]For Xbox players[/b], you can start migrating your characters to APB Reloaded on PC immediately at https://gamersfirst.com/apb/news/2024/1/2/xbox-console-2024
[*] [b]For PlayStation 4 players[/b], the migration page is not ready yet, but on February 1 you will also be able to start migrating your characters to APB Reloaded on PC. Instructions will be at https://gamersfirst.com/apb/news/2024/1/2/ps4-console-2024
[/list]
We want to express our sincere gratitude to the APB Reloaded console community for the creativity, dedication, and support you have shown over the years. We are here to support you through this transition, and our customer service team is available for any questions or concerns you might have.

You can reach support at: https://support.gamersfirst.com or can email support@gamersfirst.com


Thank you for being a part of the APB Reloaded community. We appreciate your understanding and continued support as we navigate these changes.

Sincerely,

Matthew Scott CEO

notes.title: OTW TESTING TODAY!
notes.content:
This will be a short notice! We would like to invite you all to join us today on OTW for another match making test, starting at 7PM UTC and lasting for an hour.

As we are looking into the instability issue with the new match making code, the more players that can get on the better will the testing go. So we ask of all of you if possible to log on to help us with this testing!

[b]Here are the notes for Matchmaking Improvement:[/b]
[list]
[*] With this build, we have deployed new code based on the existing matchmaking functionality on Live. We have changed the way data is interpreted, used, and calculated with multiple players, but the underlying individual skill rating formulas are the same.
[*] Matchmaking has been moved from District to World.
[*] Matchmaking will only function in the same district - at least for now. We plan on expanding matchmaking to function cross-district within the next coming weeks.
[*] Attempting to ready up cross-district will fail without any errors. This is a known issue and we are tracking it.
[*] Threat is visible for testing purposes, but may disappear in the future once we are certain the build works as intended and we have proper analytics to ensure our players are always getting the highest quality matches.
[*] Backup is disabled for this build and will not function. This will be added in a future deployment.
[*] Unopposed missions are no longer present in this build, and all missions are instantly opposed.
[*] Team alliance is non-functional and will be re-implemented.
[*] The matchmaker will no longer attempt to make matches that are unequal in size. You will be matched exactly according to initial mission sizes - 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4.
[*] Fight Club, Social and Minigame Districts will be unaffected by these changes and are outside the scope of our testing. However, they may be present.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Mayhem 2023
notes.content:
[b]From the 25th of October to the 8th of November[/b], all San Paro residents are invited to use their street war knowledge against the ghastly calamity in known and loved seasonal challenges! Choose "Headless Horseman" or "Pumpkin Pickin'" events, or do both for a chance to bank a sweet amount of Joker Tickets and one or more unique seasonal titles.

[b][u]Completing the following objectives will award you with 500 Joker Tickets and one of the seasonal titles (per objective):[/u][/b]

👻Become a Headless Horseman by raiding special Halloween districts for pumpkins in the "Headless Horseman" event. You may lose your head over it, but 500 Joker Tickets and the [b]"A Scythe to Behold"[/b] title are well worth it!

🦇Keep coming back for more, and we will notice! If you play 25 or more games during the event, we will acknowledge your persistence and give you your well-earned 500 Joker Tickets and the title of [b]"Bullet Fiend"[/b].

🎃Pumpkin heads are back in season! They’re not only gourd looking but also send a strong message... mainly that you have squashed some poor souls along the way. And if you’re counting 25 and over, we have no choice but to award your efforts with 500 Joker Tickets and title you [b]"Hollow"[/b].

🦇If you're one of the lucky ones who avoided being Jack-o'-Lantern-ized that one wonderful night in October, then you have something to be proud of! Slay 100 vengeful spirits, and we will send you home with 500 Joker Tickets, the [b]"Reaper's Friend"[/b] title, and something to tell your future grandkids about.

👻Or maybe you're just happy to be a one-hit horror lead role. Survive Headless Horseman havoc without being converted to the Pumpkin Head, and you'll get yourself some well-deserved respect, 500 Joker Tickets, and the [b]"Trick or Trigger"[/b] title!

Oh! And remember to visit our two good seasonal friends along the way. Contacts [b]Trick[/b] and [b]Treat[/b] are back to visit Halloween Waterfront for a limited time. Level them up to access their unique stash of seasonal items only available for the event.

So there you have it, and we hope you have one hallow-a-time!

...Just watch your back 😈


🎃         🎃         🎃         🎃         🎃         🎃          🎃


Still here? Well, we may have one more thing for you.

If you like to share screenshots of in-game actions, why not do so and potentially earn a valuable reward?

To participate, you need to submit your best event screenshot on [url=https://forums.gamersfirst.com/forum/6-social-district-general-discussion/]G1 Forums[/url] or under the competition announcement post on the official Little Orbit [url=https://www.facebook.com/APBReloaded]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/apb_reloaded]X(Twitter)[/url] and follow a few simple rules to get a chance of winning:

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.30.0.839845
notes.content:
A patch is going up on the Live servers for PC. This patch will be happening on Thursday 4/27/2023. The patch is scheduled to start at 2am PT / 9AM UTC and will last 4-6 hours.

[b]GENERAL CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Easy Anti Cheat is now fully implemented in APB! Launching the game will install EAC automatically. Please continue to use the /report command to report cheaters, as always!
[*] Players can now choose to disable fog. This option can be found in the Advanced Video settings (note that keeping fog enabled slightly impacts performance)

[*] Added the ability to disable Muzzle Flash and Magazine Casings. These options are in DefaultGame.ini, under APBGame.cVisualFX_Weapon called:
[list]

[/list]
[/list]

[*] FAR jump modifier changed: 20 -> 15
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: APB 1.30 is now Live!
notes.content:
APB: Reloaded has been upgraded to 64bit as part of version 1.30! It’s finally here! The upgrade to 64bit should result in better performance for a majority and, in the long run, allow the team to upgrade, fix, and improve the game further.

The Valentine’s Day event for 2023, “Seeking Love”, is now active! More information here: https://www.gamersfirst.com/apb/news/2023/2/7/v-day-2023

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list][*] A graphical glitch and potential crash vector related to the Blowtorch modification has been addressed.
[/list]
[b]FUNCTIONALITY:[/b]
[list]
[*] POWER USERS: With the release of 1.30, you are now able to adjust your clients’ frames per second (FPS) cap on your own. We do not currently have a UI for this functionality, however, you may manually adjust specific configuration files.
[*] Launch APB: Reloaded at least once after you have installed the 1.30 update.
[*] Close the game.
[*] Navigate to your APB install directory.
[olist][*] For Steam users, this is located at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common by default.
[*] For GamersFirst users, the folder is located at C:\Program Files (x86)\GamersFirst\Binaries\APB Reloaded\ by default.
[/olist]
[*] Within this folder, navigate to “APBGame\Config” after patching the game, and open the file called "APBEngine.ini".
[*] Within this file, search for the following section: [Engine.GameEngine]
[*] There are two cap types that are able to be modified in this file: "MaxClientFrameRate", and “MaxSmoothedFrameRate”. Both of these correspond to the “Smooth Framerate” option in the game’s in-game options.
[*] MaxClientFrameRate may be 0 (uncapped), or any value above MaxSmoothedFrameRate.
[*] MaxSmoothedFrameRate may be any value up to 128.
[*] Raising your FPS cap above 145 will worsen existing issues related to running above 128 fps worse – although a common bug known as sliding will happen if your fps is too stable at your current selected cap.
[*] Additionally, there is an issue related to high framerates that causes your crosshair to expand with an inaccurate accuracy value. However, this is a purely visual bug, and does not actually affect accuracy.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kNagi6h.png[/img]

[b]1.30 KNOWN ISSUES:[/b]
[list]
[*] There is a rare crash related to using Fullscreen mode and switching to other windows, commonly known as ‘alt tabbing’, especially when respawning after death.
[*] Additionally, swapping between windows in Fullscreen mode may result in performance degradation over time.[/list][olist][*] We recommend that players temporarily use the “Fullscreen Windowed” or “Windowed” mode until we address the above two issues properly.[/olist][list]
[*] There is a known issue involving some types of environmental sounds missing appropriate volume levels, as well as an issue with Joker Ammo boxes repeating their lines too often.
[*] Some districts may have incorrect lighting and shadows projected from objects that may not exist.
[*] On first launch of 1.30, players may receive errors such as, “Battleye failed to install” or an “insufficient permission” issue upon launching the game. Performing the “Repair” option on the APB Launcher application may solve these issues.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qTobq8v.png[/img]

We will be addressing the above issues in the weeks to follow as those fixes are available. We apologize for any inconvenience they may have caused.

notes.title: V-Day 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/ba97b3856931e76d37e21ff93b2f63af81f70e2b.jpg[/img]

[h1]VALENTINE EVENT 2023[/h1]

The season of Cupid is once again in full swing. Eagle-eyed and mischief-loving, we heard he stalks San Paro with a bow and arrow, fully intending to wreak havoc. Legend says that anyone struck by Cupid's arrow falls madly in love with the next person they see. Even if we don't have hordes of lovestruck, confused vigilantes running amok, we reckon an epidemic of arrow wounds is almost as bad. We got a beef with Cupid and his army of lovebugs, and we raise hot lead to his quiver and bow. Whether you're partnered up or forever alone, we make no difference. It's time to show this cranky baby what for! And why not earn some sweet treats in the process?

Love is in the air, but we are ready for it! From February 8th through February 22th, we are coming together to bring it down.

[h1]2023 Valentine's Day Activities: Seeking Love[/h1]

Cupid doesn't make things easy, but we've got your back by keeping the goods flowing through daily in-game activities. All you need to do is complete three missions for "Seeking Love" in a single day, and you'll earn rewards! You'll get a new set of different items every time you meet this objective. Do this four days in a row, and you'll earn all of the following:

[list]
[*] Day 1 = Title: "Heartseeker"; 5 Valentine's Gift Boxes
[*] Day 2 = Title: "The Hearty One"; 5 Valentine's Gift Boxes
[*] Day 3 = Title: "Sweetheart"; 5 Valentine's Gift Boxes
[*] Day 4 = Title: "A Perfect Match"; Unlock: Valentine's Quiver Backpack; 5 Valentine's Gift Boxes
[*] Want more goods? Let's arrange a little something.
[/list]

Every time you finish a mission, you'll have a chance to receive an additional pack of 2-5 Valentine's Gift Boxes!

[h1]Valentine’s Week Massacre[/h1]

The second way you can progress is by racking up kills with the following primary weapons:

[list]
[*] STAR 556 'Love-Gun' - Gifted on login (please check your in-game mail after the V-Day Patch on 2/8)
[*] Colby M-1922 'Chopper' - Level 4 reward of the 'Valentine's Week Massacre' role
[*] Joker SR15 'Casanova' - Available through ARMAS & Valentine's Gift Boxes
[*] Obeya CR762 'Heartbreaker' - Available through ARMAS & Valentine's Gift Boxes
[*] Colby CSG-20 'Speed-Dater' - Available through ARMAS & Valentine’s Gift Boxes
[*] N-HVR 243 'Cupid's Arrow' - Available through ARMAS & Valentine’s Gift Boxes
[*] STAR 556 'Love-Gun' R&D III - Available through ARMAS & Valentine’s Gift Boxes
[*] Colby M-1922 'Big Chopper' - Available through ARMAS & Valentine’s Gift Boxes
[/list]

All is fair in love and war. Laying your love to rest will advance your "Valentine's Week Massacre" role and grant you the following:

[list]
[*] 50 Kills = Death Theme: Romance
[*] 150 Kills = Clothing: Love Heart Glasses
[*] 300 Kills = Death Theme: Pizza Guy
[*] 500 Kills = Colby M-1922 'Chopper' (10-Day Lease); Clothing: Pink Police Hat; Unlock: STAR 556 'Love-Gun'
[*] 750 Kills = Title: “Casanova;” Valentine's Weapon Skin
[/list]

[h1]Snubbed Love[/h1]

Still Hungry for more? Well. If you insist.

The third way you can progress is by giving Cupid a taste of his medicine and racking up kills with the Colby SNR 850 'Cherub' secondary weapon. This weapon is gifted on login, so check your in-game mail after Valentine's Event patch.

Working on the "Snubby Love" role will grant you the following:
[list]
[*] 25 Kills = Unlock: Ophelia - Blond Decal
[*] 75 Kills = Enforcers: Prentiss Tigers "Violet Valentine" Symbol; Criminals: Bloodroses "Rose-Heart" Symbol
[*] 150 Kills = Unlock: Ophelia - Redhead Decal
[*] 250 Kills = Unlock: Colby SNR 850 'Cherub'
[*] 375 Kills = Title: “Cherub Chaser”
[/list]

The word spread and some faction contacts have joined the cause and want everyone to know it. You can find them wearing festive clothing in the Social and Financial Districts.

[b]Additionally, for a limited time during the event, the STAR 556 'LCR' "Old Glory" has reappeared for sale in ARMAS.[/b] Don't miss it! Loved by Enforcers and Criminals alike, the STAR 556 'LCR' is a throwback to the old STAR from days of old. The STAR 'LCR,' or "Low Cyclic Rate,' fires its ammunition slower but at a longer effective range. This variant comes outfitted with Hunting Sight 3, Cooling Jacket 2, and a Mobility Sling for extra stopping power at range. It's the weapon of choice for any Cupid hunter out there.

Clear your schedules, reload your guns, and join us in San Paro on February 8th!

And bring some heart into it ;)

notes.title: APB 2021 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For the last 2 years, I've done a State of the Game or Roadmap post for APB. 

This year, I'm substantially later getting this organized than I wanted to be. For that, I want to apologize.

It started with a bit of extra time off after the holiday to try and decompress from an exhausting year. I chose to do something I rarely do, which is largely disconnect from the computer. When I came back, I immediately jumped into organizing the roadmap post for 2021, but after reviewing my first draft I felt like it was mostly lip service with no actual tactical plan behind it. We hit so many road bumps last year and the year before that, I felt I owed it to the players to take a long hard look at the game and to be 100% honest about its future. That led to quite a bit more research and planning sessions which in turn further delayed this post.

I am not normally absent from the community for what has now been over a month. Truthfully, I've been so busy that I haven't had the time to sort through my forum inbox, read forum messages, or do more than the occasional retweet. As a result, I am certain there are those who immediately leapt to one of several conclusions: (1) the company is shutting down, (2) the company has been acquired, or (3) the game is being shutdown. 

I can assure you that none of those things are happening or in the works. So, with sincere gratitude for your guys’ patience, let’s take a look at the results of my deep-dive.

Before I jump into the roadmap itself, I want to briefly look back at some of the tasks we did accomplish last year.

[list]
[*] We formalized Joker Tickets as our in-game paid currency.
[*] Instead of forcing players to go to our website for paid purchases, we launched the in-game Joker Store and added hundreds of items for purchase, including guns, clothing, and vehicles.
[*] We added bundled items to the Joker Store that automatically adjust their price based on items you already own.
[*] We revamped how some purchases are delivered to player accounts so they don’t need to be kept around when not in use.
[*] We removed Joker Mystery Boxes and created an entirely new rental system for getting Legendary guns with Joker Tickets.
[*] And we added ways for players to earn Joker Tickets to finally make the game truly free to play with all content available to all players.
[/list]

We’ve come a long way, but there is still a lot to do with APB. It would be disingenuous to talk about the good without acknowledging the bad, so I also took a moment to review some of our problem areas. 

With our focus entirely on the new engine and on the transforming our store, we were largely unable to produce new content or new events. I think players would have tolerated that better had the new engine come out, but to-date we still haven't launched APB 2.1, and we haven’t seen the progress we were hoping for in our Open Betas. In addition, 2020 was a difficult year for Little Orbit overall. We still have a major project that cost the company millions of dollars held up in litigation, and while the APB playerbase grew dramatically over the summer, we ended the year at an all-time low concurrency.

So, that is where we are. Now, here is what we plan to do about it.

Many of you have seen these roadmap items before, but this year I also wanted to share more information on how we expect to get there. Here is our agenda for 2021:

[list]
[*] Complete and launch APB 2.1
[*] Marketing for APB
[*] Updated console builds
[*] Matchmaking fixes / DAM
[*] New player experience
[*] New contacts with new rewards
[*] New car, new guns, new clothing - all immediately available in the in-game Joker Store
[*] Cross play across worlds
[*] New player name strategy
[*] Phasing R&D and further matchmaking upgrades
[*] Another large overhaul of our online store
[/list]

For APB 2.1, it's become obvious that we don't currently have all the resources we need in-house to properly evaluate and solve the remaining issues. We have done 5 Open Beta tests, and while there has been a lot of hard work and some progress, it's not enough to meet our goals. To that end, we are in the process of signing deals with some Unreal 3.5 consultants that specialize in performance captures, identifying bottlenecks, and recommending specific optimizations that will work for the APB engine. 

Admittedly, these kinds of resources have been very challenging to find in the past, which is why we haven't done this before. But, after the holiday, I made this our #1 priority. After weeks of sifting through resumes and candidates, we are now ready to move forward. Additionally, we are about a quarter of the way through a massive effort to go line-by-line through every inch of the code and identify problematic areas. I have built a very aggressive timeline, shared it with my leads, and we'll get started on Feb 1st. I hope to do progress posts to share more details as we go.

The launch of APB 2.1 needs to be accompanied by real marketing. This is an area that I have been holding back since we took over because I felt it would be a waste of money to attract players to a game that just wasn't ready for them. We now have a detailed marketing plan with budgets, large partners, and targets. I am excited to finally see it in action.

Directly following our marketing push, we will jump into finalizing console builds. As I've said before, these players have suffered long enough. They will be getting all of the APB content they’ve been missing from the last 3 years along with all of the new systems and changes we have made. Beyond simply making good on my promise, it is also critical that we sync up our entire code base for the rest of what we need to do. A lot of work has already been done to pay off the technical debt we created with all the new changes to PC.

The immediate benefit of a shared codebase is that we can finally launch the District Management system. This system will have the full pool of servers that it can dynamically distribute across any of our 3 platforms as concurrency goes up and down during the day. This also means we will be able to implement cross-play across worlds. Players from the EU will be able to hop on NY or LA servers and vice versa. Console players will be able to buy, sell, trade, and participate in Social districts alongside everyone else. It also opens up our ability to investigate phasing and other possible upgrades to matchmaking.

Finally, we know you guys have been looking for ways to continue to support us. It has been incredibly gratifying to see so many of you continuing to purchase Premium despite our delivering nearly a full year of free Premium to the community. Some of you have amassed a truly impressive amount of paid Premium. To make sure we can honor that level of commitment and support, we are going to temporarily remove Premium purchase options while our free option is ongoing. We will also be deactivating reoccurring Premium payments for anyone who is still on subscription at this time, as we want to make sure that all our users get exactly what they pay for. To that end, we hope to have new things you can support us with later this year, like a new car, some well-crafted clothing, and fun guns with new twists. 

I won’t rehash the rest of the list, but in closing I do want to talk about one more thing that needs to get some focus in 2021: our new player experience. Aside from matchmaking and performance, this is the next biggest handicap for the game. Over the coming weeks, we will be organizing a series of design ideas to pick and choose a solution that will truly help players understand our mission system, contact progression, gun ranks, and mods. While we appreciate and will still need players to help mentor new blood, we can and will do much more to support onboarding new players.

Thanks,
Matt

notes.title: Legendary Beta announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/f343bfc650728a7142d89c36c60644fe03098dca.jpg[/img]

You've already read about our [url=https://www.gamersfirst.com/apb/news/2020/6/15/apb-10th-anniversary][b]10th anniversary celebration[/b][/url]. Now, we want to make the last two very big announcements that will coincide with that event. To start, we are fundamentally changing our monetization model by [b]removing JMBs[/b] and allowing you to [b]rent and obtain Legendaries with in-game Joker Tickets[/b]. Alongside these changes, we are going to start the public Open Beta for the new engine on Saturday, June 6/27. Be sure to read to the end of this post to catch it all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/03b89cccc99788f938ce08bca9af7274a4cadf95.jpg[/img]

On 6/10, Joker Gunworks started [url=https://www.gamersfirst.com/apb/news/2020/6/8/joker-store-renovations][b]renovating gun rentals[/b][/url], but there's one legendary surprise they saved for last!

After our last update, you may have spotted Anne Partridge lurking around the Joker Store. She's been on the run from RedHill and keeping things quiet, but now she's ready to don her uniform and trade her hacking skills in for Joker Gunworks' protection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/0233eb4b6d67261d2f92f59658f3d89ea283a902.jpg[/img]

Starting [b]June 24[/b], when you go into the Joker Store, Anne will be your official liaison for all those black-market deals Joker would prefer to keep off the books. She's been hacking shipments to secure more of the prototype parts and weapons they use to supply Legendaries to the public, so now she can make them available for valued Joker Gunworks customers to rent all the time.

Let's take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/9205cddd53e2f5f8585b0a784531f438fa56dd7f.png[/img]

There are a few things to note about this new menu. First, you can now rent Legendaries with Joker Tickets directly from the in-game Joker Store instead of going through ARMAS. Paying the rental price will unlock the Legendary for 7 days, which means you can try them out and see what matches your playstyle the best.

Anne likes repeat business and she likes to tease her customers. Occasionally, she'll make a "mistake" and not log that you rented the gun. Then you get to keep it for good. This means that, each time you rent from her, you have a 5% chance to permanently unlock that same Legendary for good. Once it's yours, that character can keep it, trade it, or sell it - whatever you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/935dbf5fabfdee378c0179c94f45a15b1951da5b.png[/img]

But what happens if you don't get lucky?

Don't worry, Anne has you covered! If you test a Legendary enough times, she'll give you the gun anyway as thanks for all the valuable field data you've collected. Here's how it works:

You may have noticed those green bars in the first menu we showed you. With Joker Gunworks' rental loyalty program, each rental where you don't get a permanent drop will fill that green bar slightly. Once a bar is completely full (around 20 rentals without a permanent unlock), your next rental is a guaranteed permanent drop! Whenever you get a permanent version, the bar is reset. For the first time ever, players can save up Joker Tickets to play with Legendaries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/0ff003ea5f3b90693b0a442be7ee1cb0354975f1.png[/img]

As part of this change, we are finally retiring the Joker Mystery Boxes from ARMAS. We are moving away from loot boxes that never guarantee anything and often result in junk rewards you didn't want. Starting June 24th, if you want to speed things up, you can directly purchase bundles of Joker Tickets from ARMAS at a rate of 100G1C for 500JT.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/abc0ff444859c636edb609a7cd0cad04834b0eb9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/da07926ea63b499d28c7810074c4eb50f5943a42.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/d7352ba0da8006dd34697f129841cafc5e24423e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/78ab7aced2131eee0132a43ac31d3b3d414e833d.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/bcb792b837b10ab39902f750786473a3dc4c4298.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/7a3ad71f600562adde2fec58ba8198bb72164a62.jpg[/img][/url]

As a thank you for your support, you get a bonus 1% chance at a permanent Legendary gun from the entire pool for each 500 Joker Tickets that you purchase this way. The advantage of this system is that we get to keep the jackpot moments that you guys love with absolutely no downside. You will always get the exact value for your money, and if you don't get the bonus, you can still use those Joker Tickets you purchased to get the exact Legendary that you want.

We hope that this new system will empower both new and old players to progress the way they want in APB. Whether you build up Joker Tickets through play or support us directly through purchases, all our guns now have a path for you to rent, try, and eventually own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952646/9712c945088f4f736f9d6b3fc58eff62edc35368.jpg[/img]

We are finally ready to open the Beta client to you all!

Our first Open Beta will run from [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=APB+Reloaded+Engine+Upgrade+-+1st+Open+Beta&iso=20200627T11&p1=137&ah=3][b]11am-2pm Pacific[/b][/url] on Saturday, June 27th. It will have two districts available for you to use - Social and Asylum. To join, you will need to download the Beta client [url=http://apb.patch.beta.gamersfirst.com/APB_Beta_Installer.exe][b]here[/b][/url] and log in using your existing APB account. Please note that [b]we will continue to update the client as we gear up for this test[/b]. If you have a limited connection, you may want to hold off downloading the client until Friday.

The first time you enter, we will copy over your characters from Live so you can try out the build for yourself.

Here are some things to remember when playing the Open Beta:

[list]
[*] When selecting a district, the client will automatically connect you to the region with the best ping for you. If you want to change your region manually, you can do so by going to the "advanced tab." Players from Jericho and Citadel can mix and match on any server they want.
[*] The numbers you use for mouse sensitivity and handling in the Live client will not be the same as what you need to use in the Beta. Because numbers scale differently in the new client, we can't give you a 1:1 conversion for your settings. Please experiment and find what numbers feel best for you.
[*] Finally, please remember that this is a Beta! Things will break. In fact, we hope you guys will help us stress the heck out of this build. Every issue you find and report brings us one step closer to the Full release, so please be sure to get us all your feedback on the forums. Below are some instructions on where and how to do that in a constructive manner.
[/list]

[h2]LEAVING FEEDBACK[/h2]
Once you've had a chance to try things out, we'd love to hear from you.

We've made a dedicated section on the forums where you can go to let us know what you think, check out our known issues, and leave any bugs you might find. You can check that out [url=https://forums.gamersfirst.com/forum/152-apb-21-beta/][b]here[/b][/url]. Please be sure to leave your feedback in this new section and not in the forum's Social District section. There's a lot of stuff to unpack with the Beta, and we want to make sure we hear from every one of you. Posting in the right place will ensure your voice is heard.

This beta test is just one stop on our road to a Full Release, but it is an important one. Thank you for your patience on this journey, and we hope you will join us for this latest milestone.

notes.title: Free Premium until further notice
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

I'm sure by now that everyone has seen the impact of coronavirus (COVID-19) on their city, work, schools, and entertainment. 

Starting Monday the 16th until the foreseeable future, all Little Orbit employees will be working remotely until we get different guidance from health officials. We prepped all week to make sure teams had hardware and instructions on how to check in during the day with their leads for tasks and updates. 

Come hell or high water, the team is dedicated to shipping the Engine Upgrade, and we didn't get this close to be sidelined by this situation.

I know this may be a little scary right now. And APB is just a game. But since many of you will be temporarily home due to work or supporting family members, we want to insure that the game is online and available for all our players to distract themselves with some missions, fight club, or a little virtual socialization in Breakwater. 

I'm also going to be turning on Free Premium for all players. 

We will be snapshotting the active Premium days for everyone, and we'll extend those days once everything goes back to normal. Hopefully that will make Social a little more fun for the time being. 

I'm also going to ask for everyone's patience with us. 
We are going to do our best to make this as smooth as possible. 

And most of all, wash your hands. Don't touch your face. Avoid large gatherings. 
Stay safe. 

Thanks,
Matt
Little Orbit CEO
